what: The 9.84M decoder's 1,000-step language-model run at four threads, BCIR (kblock+exp+reduce) against PyTorch 2.13 eager and torch.compile at four intra-op threads (train_comparison.py train --task lm --threads 4 --eval-every 100 --lr-scale 0.25; PyTorch's thread count set by the harness since this record, torch_threads recorded), on one host in one session.
